trained_on: UCI Cleveland heart disease (expanded heart.csv), de-duplicated
honesty_note: leaky_duplicate_split_accuracy is what you get by splitting the raw CSV with its duplicated rows; it is inflated by train/test leakage and must not be quoted. Use held_out metrics.
scope_note: Tabular clinical-variable risk estimate. Not part of the image screening pipeline and not a substitute for ECG, angiography or clinical assessment.
